items.title: What Does Intel (INTC) Gain From Its Texas Chip Facility Joint Venture?
items.summary: Intel (NasdaqGS: INTC) announces a joint venture with SpaceX and Tesla to build a semiconductor fabrication facility in Texas as part of the Terafab project. The Terafab facility is intended to support chips for next generation robotics and autonomous vehicle platforms used by SpaceX and Tesla. The partnership highlights efforts by the companies to tighten control over chip supply for AI hardware and advanced manufacturing in North America.
